One-page lookup from familiar LIC-DSF sheets to `lic_dsf` types and demos.

## Pipeline

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  xlsx[Workbook_xlsx]
  loaders[Loaders]
  portfolio[PVPortfolio]
  ext[ExternalDebtBook]
  macro[MacroDebtBook]
  dsa[Baseline_dsa]
  stress[stress]
  realism[realism]
  rating[rating]
  scenario[scenario]
  panels[Output_panels]

  xlsx --> loaders
  loaders --> portfolio
  loaders --> ext
  portfolio --> ext
  loaders --> macro
  ext --> macro
  macro --> dsa
  ext --> dsa
  dsa --> stress
  macro --> stress
  dsa --> realism
  dsa --> rating
  stress --> rating
  rating --> scenario
  dsa --> panels
  stress --> panels
  realism --> panels
  rating --> panels
  scenario --> panels
```

## Sheet map

| Excel | Package / type | Demo |
|-------|----------------|------|
| Input 4 / `PV_Base` | `PresentValueInstrument`, `lic_dsf.load.load_instruments_from_workbook` | [`pv`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/pv.ipynb) |
| Input 5 / `PV_LC_NR*` | `LocalCurrencyNonResidentInstrument`, `lic_dsf.load.load_lc_nr_instruments_from_workbook` | [`lc_nr`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/lc_nr.ipynb) |
| Combined new MLT | `PVPortfolio` | [`portfolio`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/portfolio.ipynb) |
| `Ext_Debt_Data` | `ExternalDebtBook`, `lic_dsf.load.load_external_debt_inputs` | [`ext_debt`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/ext_debt.ipynb) |
| `Dom_Debt_Data` / indicators | `DomesticDebtBook`, `lic_dsf.load.load_domestic_debt_inputs` | [`dom_debt`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/dom_debt.ipynb) |
| `Macro-Debt_Data` | `MacroDebtBook`, `lic_dsf.load.load_macro_debt_inputs` | [`macro_debt`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/macro_debt.ipynb) |
| Input 7 residual terms | `lic_dsf.load.load_input7_residual_params`, `ResidualFinancingParams` | used in stress demos |
| Baseline – external / public | `BaselineExternalBook`, `BaselinePublicBook` | [`baseline_dsa`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/baseline_dsa.ipynb) |
| Output 1-1 / 1-2 | `lic_dsf.output.external_dsa_panel`, `public_dsa_panel` | [`baseline_dsa`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/baseline_dsa.ipynb) |
| Input 6 standard stresses | `lic_dsf.load.load_input6_standard`, `run_standard_external_stress`, … | [`stress_dsa`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/stress_dsa.ipynb) |
| Output 2 / 3 (B / B1 paths) | `lic_dsf.output.stress_external_panel`, `stress_public_panel` | [`stress_dsa`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/stress_dsa.ipynb) |
| Realism 1–4 / Output 4 | `lic_dsf.load` capital/multiplier/imported parsers, `lic_dsf.realism` math, `lic_dsf.output` panels | [`realism`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/realism.ipynb) |
| CI Summary / Classification | `lic_dsf.load.load_ci_summary`, `DebtCarryingCapacity`, thresholds | [`risk_rating`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/risk_rating.ipynb) |
| Chart Data / Output 5 / 7 | `ChartDataRegistry`, `compute_mechanical_ratings`, `risk_summary_panel` | [`output_7`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/output_7.ipynb), [`risk_rating`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/risk_rating.ipynb) |
| Customized Scenario / Probability / Output 6 | `CustomizedScenarioSpec`, `lic_dsf.output.probability_panel` | [`output_6`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/output_6.ipynb) |
| Full Outputs tour | all of the above | [`all_outputs`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/all_outputs.ipynb) |

## Package roles (one line each)

| Package | Owns | Does not own |
|---------|------|--------------|
| `lic_dsf.pv` | Instruments, Ext/Dom/Macro books, ResFin instrument math | Baseline ratio panels, ratings, Excel parsers |
| `lic_dsf.load` | Input / CI / Realism sheet parsers | Ratio math, shocks, Output frames |
| `lic_dsf.dsa` | Baseline external/public sustainability ratios | Stress shocks, CI thresholds, Output DataFrames |
| `lic_dsf.output` | Output-sheet panels and Excel-geometry tables | Ratio math, shocks, ratings |
| `lic_dsf.stress` | Input 6 shocks, ResFin overlays, B/B1 paths | Baseline-only math, final rating |
| `lic_dsf.realism` | Realism 1–4 math | Chart Data, risk ratings, Output 4 frames |
| `lic_dsf.rating` | CI thresholds, breaches, mechanical ratings | DSA ratio numerators |
| `lic_dsf.scenario` | Customized paths, probability math | Input 8 SDR (lives in Ext via `pv`); Output 6 frames |
